summary: The web app now signs people in with Microsoft's built-in Container Apps sign-in.

fixes.title: Microsoft's sign-in now guards the web app
fixes.text: Microsoft's own Container Apps sign-in now stands in front of the web app, so a request without a sign-in never reaches it. No secret is used, and the app still checks each sign-in itself.

fixes.title: Fewer rights for the web app
fixes.text: The web app's identity holds no Key Vault right any more, and the update job can no longer change the web app's sign-in registration.
